recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Future work for additional current genomics interaction examples should target the Genomics Reporting IG or current MolecularDefinition/GenomicStudy-family artifacts rather than the retired DSTU2 core example set.
issue_request: FHIR-11234 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and asked for full XML/JSON example sets showing how genomic resources interact, with a resolution to add PGx examples from FHIR-11013 and TPMT gene-mutation examples covering Observation-genetics and Sequence.
initial_application: Commit b2b49e7e2bb0572d2de4ba7516e2c44df48751b2 explicitly resolved #11234 and added PGx DiagnosticReport/DiagnosticRequest, Observation, and Sequence examples, TPMT Observation/Sequence examples, images, and links from source/genomics.html.
additional_context: Later Clinical Genomics work deprecated/refactored the old core genomics profiles/examples toward the Genomics Reporting IG, renamed Sequence to MolecularSequence, and then removed the outdated Clinical Genomics artifacts. Current source/fhir.ini comments out MolecularSequence and keeps MolecularDefinition active; current source/genomics.html points to the Genomics Reporting IG, MolecularDefinition, molecular data-type work, and external use cases. Active MolecularDefinition examples now cover sequence, allele, variation, haplotype, genotype, CYP2C19, and HLA relationship patterns.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Restoring the old PGx/TPMT Observation-genetics-to-Sequence examples would reintroduce retired core artifacts and conflict with later WG/source direction.
